entry.title: Saint Amalberga of Temse (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Saint Amalberga of Temse (pictured) is the patron saint of upper-limb injuries, because of the legend that Charlemagne broke her arm while trying to force her to marry him?
